qa.a: I love animals, particularly mammals. I really because they're the closest to us relatively speaking. I think they're quite cool.
Oh, I'm definitely a dog person. I really love dogs just in general. And of course, they're domesticated animals, so you can always keep them quite close to you and that's really good as well.

qa.q: What wild animal do you like the most?
qa.a: I love big cats, in particular tigers. They really stand out with this color scheme on their fur. And then of course, they also portray the sense of majesty and power as well when they are moving. It's really interesting to watch.

qa.q: Have you ever seen any wild animals before?
qa.a: Yes, actually. I used to teach in a school in Africa which was quite close to a riverbed, and so sometimes crocodiles would just wander into the school grounds, which was always very exciting.

qa.q: Do you like to go to the zoo?
qa.a: Um, I used to like going to the zoo more as a child. I think we still have that sense of wonder when we're children, whereas now, um, it's kind of a double-edged sword because you can see the animals, which isn't great, but you're also quite sad because they're in captivity and that's also quite sad. But what's the alternative? If they're in the wild, then they don't have this protection.

qa.q: Why do some people keep pets at home?
qa.a: Oh, lots of different reasons, really. I think one of the main reasons is because they're cute. Of course, all these domesticated animals look lovely. But, in addition to that, they have some utility as well, like dogs, for example, are kept as guard dogs to protect your property. But it's not always about defense. People also keep cats and even goldfish for therapeutic purposes, for example. So, there's lots of different reasons, really. I think those are the main ones though.
